-118.53300,34.17040.name: The Center for Fertility and Gynecology, Vermesh Center for Fertility
-118.53300,34.17040.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Michael Vermesh, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-1.95228,50.72702.name: Wessex at Poole
-1.95228,50.72702.state: BWT Physio, 1 Springfield Road, Ashley Cross, Poole, Dorset, BH14 0LG
-1.95228,50.72702.company: Satellite clinic to TFP Wessex Fertility
-1.95228,50.72702.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to TFP Wessex Fertility. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-121.76200,38.53800.name: Rewriting Extinction / genetic biocontrol programmes
-121.76200,38.53800.desc: Research toward using engineered organisms for conservation — suppressing invasive species, rescuing populations too small to recover. The conservation case is the strongest argument for deliberate release, and it is being made by people with no commercial interest in the outcome.

27.09720,-26.71450.name: Grain SA and the commercial maize sector
27.09720,-26.71450.desc: The South African commercial grain producers' organisation, in the country with the highest adoption of engineered maize in Africa and the only one where it is a staple food rather than feed. South Africans eat engineered white maize directly, which makes it the one place where the food-crop argument is not hypothetical.

-74.66720,40.35730.name: Labcorp Early Development (Covance)
-74.66720,40.35730.state: Princeton, New Jersey — 671 US Highway One
-74.66720,40.35730.desc: One of the largest contract research organisations in the world, running toxicology and safety studies on behalf of clients whose names do not appear in the resulting submission. The regulator reads the study; the public reads the sponsor. Between those two sits a company most people have never heard of, holding the animals and the data.

4.88300,52.38600.name: Greenpeace International
4.88300,52.38600.desc: The most-cited opponent of agricultural biotechnology for three decades, and the counterparty in the Golden Rice dispute, where 150 Nobel laureates signed a letter against its position in 2016. Whatever one concludes about that argument, the organisation is a principal in it and the map recorded the industry's side without it.
